main_text.p: Primum eft,pro donorum differentia ad vocati-onem bonam difponere.Gen.4.3.4.
Secundum,eft ad vitam fanctè degendam guber-nare.Eius duo membra.
Hic autem primogenito ius fuum tribuendum, quod eft portio duorum ex omnibus quæ præstò sunt.Deut.22.17.
Secundum membrum eft, vt in omnibus quæ alicuius funt momenti(præcipuè autem in matrimonio contrahendo)conceffu & confilio fuo, ipfos dirigant.2.Cor.12.14.Gen.24.1.
Patris proprium eft nomen idoneum i. idiomati vulgari aliquid pietatis conuenienter exprimens liberis imponere.Gen.4.25. & 16.15.
Matris proprium eft τεχνοτροφεῖν id eft,ablaćtare, fafcijs inuoluere,&c.1.Tim.5.10.Gen.21.7.8. 1.Sam. 1.23.Luc.2.12.
Οἰκέται,funt omnes qui in eadem familia ad ministrationem εὐλαξίας subijciuntur.
Οἰκετῶν ς Generale. officia funt ζ Specialia.
Generale duplex. Prius eft vt in præced. omnibus subiectionem & obed.præstant. Posterius eft vt inter fe pro fua virili promoueant.

page.notes: Left margin fragments (partly cut off at the scan edge, e.g. "aritum", "Dei", "ma re-", "gestu", "tem-", "eorū", "præ-", "cepta", "3.16") are running text of the facing page or edge bleed and are not transcribed. The Greek in "τεχνοτροφεῖν" and "εὐλαξίας" and the Greek in the outline are reproduced as best read; accents and some letters may be doubtful. The outline brace layout is rendered as running text rather than <l type="diagram"> boxes; the right-hand brace label "Spe-" is the catchword/hyphenated word continuing on the next page. Possible printing error: "Οἰκέται" may be Οἰκέται as printed.
